firstPlayerRule: Whoever most recently watched or read a thriller goes first.
houseFallback: If nobody qualifies, the timing is tied or unclear, or your group prefers another approach, agree to choose randomly. This is this site’s suggested house rule.
clarifications: The game is cooperative but uses individual character turns. Card exchanges are allowed before movement and after the action under the normal exchange restrictions.
For solo play, control two characters of your choice.
Specific instructions on cards or in the adventure book take precedence over the general rulebook.
